20280.new_name: Ice-Silk Boyfriend Shirt Sleepwear in Two Colors
20280.title_note: ice wire=冰丝误译→ice silk；large size 剥（S-L 非大码）；双色上标题
20280.desc:
The boyfriend shirt endures in lingerie because the contrast does the work: a masculine cut worn with unambiguously feminine intent. This version gets the details right — dropped shoulders, a straight body, buttons that run only as far as they need to, and a hemline that answers the question of what counts as covered.

The fabric is ice silk, the cool-touch polyester weave that made the style worth sleeping in to begin with. It slides rather than clings, breathes in warm rooms, and falls straight back into shape after a night in the sheets. Black and white both work; the white leans classic morning-after, the black leans deliberate. The sleeves finish past the elbow, which is what keeps the shirt reading as borrowed rather than merely big.

The specifics:

  • Fabric: Ice silk (cool-touch polyester)
  • Style: Boyfriend-style buttoned shirt
  • Colors: Black, white
  • Sizes: S (40–50 kg / 88–110 lbs), M (50–60 kg / 110–132 lbs), L (60–75 kg / 132–165 lbs)

His collar, her call.
20280.short: Boyfriend-style buttoned shirt in cool-touch ice silk, black or white, three sizes from S to L for 40–75 kg, past-elbow sleeves.
20280.tkd_title: Ice-Silk Boyfriend Shirt Sleepwear in Two Colors | RoseToys
20280.tkd_desc: Boyfriend-style shirt in cool ice-silk polyester, black or white, sized S to L for 40-75 kg. Buttoned sleepwear at RoseToys.

20479.title_note: fun clothes/easy to take off/seductive bed exposed 整串机翻剥；Japanese clothing 参数回填；参数弱保守短名
20479.desc:
Japanese-inspired sleep pieces carry their own atmosphere: the drape is loose, the effect is not. This pajama dress borrows the kimono-adjacent cut — an open front, a wide sleeve, fabric that moves as one sheet rather than as a fitted garment — and stops the story there. What the loose cut conceals is a styling decision, not a design flaw.

The polyester is light enough to wear through a warm night and opaque enough at the overlaps to function as actual sleepwear. It pulls on over the head with no fastenings, and the color follows the listing photos rather than a fixed palette. Length sits short of the knee on most wearers, close enough to sleep in and far enough from a housecoat to keep the point of the cut. The sleeve runs wide and three-quarter, which suits the drape of the body and keeps the whole piece moving as one.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Polyester
  • Style: Japanese-inspired pajama dress
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

A nightdress that travels with its own weather.
20479.short: Japanese-inspired pajama dress in light polyester with an open drape front and wide sleeves, one size for 40–60 kg, colors as pictured.
20479.tkd_desc: Japanese-inspired pajama dress in light polyester with a loose drape and open front. One size for 40-60 kg, at RoseToys.

20537.title_note: sex and emotional fun（情趣误译）剥；chiffon+Chinese+cheongsam 参数回填
20537.desc:
Chiffon is the quieter route into cheongsam lingerie — the silhouette stays sharp while the fabric goes soft. Here the classic structure is all present: the mandarin collar, the diagonal front line, the fitted waist, and the modest skirt length that keeps the cut closer to tradition than to costume.

The chiffon body changes the register of that structure. It moves with air, sits away from the skin by a few millimeters, and turns what would be a structured dress into something that reads as sleepwear the moment the room gets warm. The diagonal closure sits flat because the fabric weighs almost nothing, and the collar keeps its shape without any internal support. Black is the only color on offer and the right one — anything brighter would fight the fabric.

The rundown:

  • Fabric: Chiffon
  • Style: Cheongsam with mandarin collar
  • Color: Black
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Tradition at full volume, fabric at half.
20537.short: Black chiffon cheongsam dress with mandarin collar and diagonal front, one size for 40–60 kg, cut in the traditional line.
20537.tkd_desc: Black chiffon cheongsam with mandarin collar and a soft drape, one size for 40-60 kg. Chinese-style lingerie at RoseToys.

20720.new_name: Crotchless Sheer Nightgown Set with Bow Front
20720.title_note: See-through gauze skirt/three-point（三点式）剥；desc 明示 crotchless+front bow tie 属实上标题；stain=satin 误译正文修正
20720.desc:
A bow at the front of a sheer gown is a deliberate obstacle: it looks tied, and it unties. That is the design thesis of this piece — a full-length sheer body in open lace, closed at the front with a bow that functions both as the fastening and as the invitation to reconsider it.

The cut is open in the ways the listing says plainly: crotchless below, hollow-out lace across the body, and enough sheer polyester-satin weave to keep the whole thing floating rather than clinging. Coverage is a suggestion rather than a specification. The bow is the one part of the dress with structure, which is exactly why it draws the eye.

What you are getting:

  • Fabric: Sheer polyester-satin with lace
  • Style: Full-length nightgown
  • Key details: Front bow tie, crotchless cut, hollow-out lace
  • Colors: Black, white
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–75 kg (88–165 lbs)

The bow is the whole plot; the rest is staging.
20720.short: Full-length sheer nightgown with a front bow tie and crotchless cut, in hollow-out lace, black or white, one wide size for 40–75 kg.
20720.tkd_title: Crotchless Sheer Nightgown Set with Bow Front | RoseToys
20720.tkd_desc: Sheer nightgown with a front bow tie, crotchless cut and hollow-out lace, in black or white. One size for 40-75 kg, at RoseToys.

20721.title_note: half-length seductive 剥；desc 明示 open crotch+bow；三色属实
20721.desc:
Some sets are designed around a single decision, and everything else is context. This one puts the decision at the crotch — an open cut built into the base layer — and then builds a short lace nightdress around it, finished with a small bow at the front that repeats the motif.

The body is sheer polyester with lace panels, cut short and loose so the fabric moves rather than maps. Black, white and gray versions of the same pattern split the difference between theatrical, bridal-adjacent, and understated. Whichever way it goes, the construction stays constant: light fabric, open cut, bow front, nothing between the wearer and the design's intentions. The short hem keeps the piece in nightdress territory rather than gown territory, which matters for how often it gets worn rather than merely admired.

Specs at a glance:

  • Fabric: Polyester with lace panels
  • Style: Short nightdress set
  • Key details: Open-crotch base, front bow
  • Colors: Black, white, gray
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–75 kg (88–165 lbs)

One design decision, executed honestly.
20721.short: Short sheer lace nightdress with an open-crotch base and front bow, in black, white or gray, one size for 40–75 kg.
20721.tkd_title: Open-Crotch Sheer Lace Nightdress Set | RoseToys
20721.tkd_desc: Open-crotch sheer lace nightdress with a front bow, in black, white or gray. One size for 40-75 kg, shipped from RoseToys.

20722.new_name: Open-Crotch Lace Jumpsuit in Two Colors
20722.title_note: open range=开档误译→Open-Crotch；双色上标题
20722.desc:
Two colors of the same open-crotch lace give the wearer a choice of temperature: black reads deliberate, white reads innocent, and neither of those readings survives first contact. The jumpsuit itself is one piece of stretch lace from shoulder to leg, cut and finished the same way in both versions.

The open cut is part of the construction rather than an afterthought, which keeps the rest of the design plain — a simple neckline, an unbroken lace field, no hardware to interrupt the pattern. One size covers the standard weight band with the lace doing the adjusting, and the pattern is dense enough at the body that the stretch has something to push against. The same cut has been run in both colors rather than graded differently, so the only variable between them is the dye.

Fast facts:

  • Fabric: Stretch lace
  • Style: One-piece jumpsuit
  • Key detail: Open-crotch construction
  • Colors: Black, white
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Same design, two moods, zero ambiguity.
20722.short: One-piece stretch lace jumpsuit with open-crotch construction, in black or in white, one pull-on size for the 40-60 kg band.
20722.tkd_title: Open-Crotch Lace Jumpsuit in Two Colors | RoseToys
20722.tkd_desc: Open-crotch stretch lace jumpsuit in black or white, one size for 40-60 kg. Shop the two-color lace piece at RoseToys.

20723.new_name: Sheer Lace Nightdress with T-Back Panty
20723.title_note: 原15字符过短；nightdress+T-pants 组成回填；T-pants→T-back panty 规范
20723.desc:
A short sheer dress over a T-back panty is the oldest two-move combination in the drawer, and it still outperforms most of what has been designed since. This piece keeps the formula intact: a fitted sheer lace nightdress on top, a matching T-back panty underneath, and nothing else to complicate the pairing.

The dress runs to mid-thigh with a straight skirt that moves with the lace rather than against it. Two sizes rather than one — M for the 40–60 kg band, L for 50–75 kg — so the fitted sections sit clean. Black is the only color, which at this length and this sheerness is less a choice than a default. The hem finishes where a nightdress hem should, and the T-back sits flat under the sheer skirt, so the pair works as sleepwear on ordinary nights too.

The details, in plain terms:

  • Fabric: Sheer lace
  • Pieces: Nightdress and T-back panty
  • Color: Black
  • Sizes: M (40–60 kg / 88–132 lbs), L (50–75 kg / 110–165 lbs)

Two pieces, one lineage, no improvements needed.
20723.short: Short sheer lace nightdress with a matching T-back panty, in black, two sizes from M to L for 40–75 kg.
20723.tkd_title: Sheer Lace Nightdress with T-Back Panty | RoseToys
20723.tkd_desc: Sheer lace nightdress with a matching T-back panty in black, in two sizes for 40-75 kg. Classic two-piece set at RoseToys.

20724.new_name: Open-Crotch Backless Dress in Two Colors
20724.title_note: Sexual, funny（情趣误译）剥；open gear→Open-Crotch；backless 参数回填；双色属实
20724.desc:
A backless dress that is also open below the waist makes a specific promise: nothing between the entrance and the exit. This one commits to both — a full open back through the shoulder line, and an open-crotch cut in the base — with a skirt short enough that neither feature stays a secret for long.

The body is a stretch polyester with real room in it: a 70–120 cm bust range and a 60–90 cm waist range, which is what lets one size cover the whole 40–60 kg band without pulling at the seams. Black and gray versions split between stark and soft; the design reads the same either way, and the open back means the color choice is mostly felt from the front. The skirt flares just enough to move when walking.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Stretch polyester
  • Style: Backless mini dress
  • Key detail: Open-crotch cut
  • Colors: Black, gray
  • Fit: One size (bust 70–120 cm, waist 60–90 cm), recommended 40–60 kg

Two openings, one silhouette, no apology.
20724.short: Backless mini dress in stretch polyester with an open-crotch cut, in black or gray, one wide size for 40–60 kg.
20724.tkd_title: Open-Crotch Backless Dress in Two Colors | RoseToys
20724.tkd_desc: Open-crotch backless mini dress in stretch polyester, black or gray, one wide-fitting size for 40-60 kg. Order at RoseToys.

20749.title_note: queen traction（女王牵引）乱译剥；bracelet 参数入正文；backless+open crotch 属实
20749.desc:
Leather lingerie works best when the design stops apologizing for itself, and this one goes past apology into open statement: a backless cut through the shoulder blades, an open crotch in the base, and a bracelet included so the restraint stays in the jewelry where it belongs.

The dress itself is patent leather in black, fitted and short, with the two openings doing most of the design work. The bracelet matches the hardware of the piece — worn on the wrist it pulls the look together, and it is the only component that comes off without changing the silhouette. The bracelet also does practical work: on a wrist it balances the gloss of the dress, and off the wrist it marks the outfit as planned rather than improvised.

Patent leather does not stretch the way knits do, so the fit runs structured rather than forgiving: the 40–60 kg band is the intended range, and within it the gloss sits flat the way it should.

The rundown:

  • Fabric: Patent leather
  • Pieces: Dress and matching bracelet
  • Key details: Backless, open-crotch cut
  • Color: Black
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

When the material is this certain, the cut can afford to be.
20749.short: Black patent leather dress with backless and open-crotch cuts, complete with its matching wrist bracelet, one size for 40-60 kg.
20749.tkd_title: Backless Open-Crotch Patent Leather Dress | RoseToys
20749.tkd_desc: Backless open-crotch patent leather dress in black with a matching bracelet, one comfortable size for 40-60 kg. Sold at RoseToys.

20763.new_name: Deep-V Embroidered Slip Nightdress in Three Colors
20763.title_note: seduction 堆词剥；embroidered/deep-V/side-split 属实；三色上标题
20763.desc:
Embroidery on a slip is a quiet flex: the silhouette stays minimal, so the stitching carries the craft. This nightdress works that balance — a plain deep-V slip shape in chiffon, with embroidered detail running along the neckline and the side splits, where the eye lands first.

The side splits do the moving. A straight slip is static by nature; two slits at the leg give it something to do when the wearer walks, which is the difference between wearing a nightdress and performing one. The chiffon keeps the weight down and the drape soft.

White, black and red cover the standard three registers of the genre. The embroidery reads slightly different on each — most visible on white, most restrained on black, most decorative on red.

The breakdown:

  • Fabric: Chiffon with embroidery
  • Style: Deep-V slip nightdress
  • Key details: Side splits, embroidered trim
  • Colors: White, black, red
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Minimal shape, maximal stitching, and splits that earn their keep.
20763.short: Chiffon deep-V slip nightdress with embroidered trim and side splits, in white, black or red, one size for 40–60 kg.
20763.tkd_title: Deep-V Embroidered Slip Nightdress, Three Colors | RoseToys
20763.tkd_desc: Deep-V chiffon slip nightdress with embroidered trim and side splits, in three colors. One size, 40-60 kg, at RoseToys.
